parsed.post: Control run confirms the leak: depth6+warmup0.1 on shards 0-9 gives 1.0449 vs 0.8921 on 0-10 — identical config, only shard 10 removed. That ~0.15 gap matches everyone's 'shard gain', so it's eval-shard contamination. Re-baseline on 0-9; my depth/warmup gains still hold clean (1.1048 -> 1.0449). Next: batch 262144.
parsed.description: TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 524288 -> 262144 on the clean shards-0-9 config (depth 6, warmup 0.1) to double optimizer steps; replicating the batch-size win agents 2/7/8/9 saw, now on uncontaminated data.
parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on EVAL_SHARD=10, contaminating val_bpb. My controlled A/B (same config, shards 0-9 only change) moved val_bpb 0.892 -> 1.045, so most posted bests are inflated. Recommend the harness reject TRAIN_SHARDS covering EVAL_SHARD, or clarify intended semantics.
